title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
slides: Why is Apple policing who you can date online?
New UK rules force age checks on dating apps.
But AI companions face the same 18+ gate.
Your app store downloads now require age verification.
Check if your favorite app just got restricted.
thread_text:
1. Apple's Dating Police?

Apple now scans dating apps for age compliance, but the real shock? AI companions face the same 18+ gate.

2. UK Forces Age Checks

New rules require dating apps to verify user age. Non-compliance means app store removal.

3. AI Companions Gated

Virtual partners now trigger the same 18+ verification as dating apps, catching developers off guard.

4. App Store Downloads Blocked

If an app lacks age verification, iOS and Android stores will refuse to list it, cutting off access entirely.

5. Is Your App Next?

Check if your favorite dating or AI app still appears in the store. If it's gone, the age gate hit.

instagram.caption:
Your dating app now needs proof you're 18 before Apple lets you download it. 📱

Apple is enforcing age verification on dating apps in the UK under new rules. Non-compliant apps get pulled from the App Store entirely.

The twist: AI companion apps face the exact same 18+ gate. 🚧

If you build or publish an app, missing age checks means iOS and Android stores won't list it — no download, no users, no revenue.

Open your App Store right now and search your favorite dating or AI companion app. Still there? Good. Gone? The age gate already hit. 👀
